scripts.lint: eslint app.js items.js eforts-code.js parent.js parent-pdf.js tests/**/*.js
scripts.lint:fix: eslint app.js items.js eforts-code.js parent.js parent-pdf.js tests/**/*.js --fix
scripts.format: prettier --check app.js items.js eforts-code.js parent.js parent-pdf.js styles.css parent.css tests/**/*.js
scripts.format:fix: prettier --write app.js items.js eforts-code.js parent.js parent-pdf.js styles.css parent.css tests/**/*.js
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run format && npx playwright test --reporter=list
